title: A local cancel before the job registers settles nothing, so the agent and MCP hang for 30 minutes
description: commandExecutor.js exec.cancel() (~line 1329): with exec.jobId still null it falls back to a bare getEngine().interrupt(). generationStore never records the cancel and no onCancel/onError fires, so the connector's held generate request hangs until its 30-min JOB_TIMEOUT (in-app agent and MCP clients both), and generationService cancelRunningCueJob returns true ('cancelled'). Live 2026-09-25: a MiniMax H3 job cancelled 11 s after submit was still 'running' 9 min later, no file, no callback. Fix: a pre-register cancel must reach a terminal store phase and fire the exec's cancel callback. Evidence: tasks/MPI-593/validation.md 'Phase 2 items 1b, 1c and 3'. Reported by peer 'Agent integration plan 2' (MPI-593).
